trace.question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
trace.evidence: name refers to superhero_name; the tallest hero refers to MAX(height_cm); published by Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

attempts.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC

trace.final_sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC
